_about: Viral Watch (Route A) settings, read by netlify/functions/viral-watch/. Every number here is THEORY v1: a starting guess to tune from the viral-log blobs. Secrets never go in this file; they live in Netlify environment variables.

active_hours._note: Runs only between start and end, Pacific time. VIRAL_MAX_UNTIL (ISO time) extends a TV/verdict night; values more than max_until_cap_hours ahead are ignored so a stale setting cannot run all night forever.

watch._note: Cases come from src/data/court-calendar.tsv: rows dated from lookback_days ago through days_ahead from today (Pacific), plus rows marked ongoing. Only cases with an NEP page are searched. term_overrides replace the auto-built search names for a case whose name column contains case_contains.

term_overrides._why: "Charlie Kirk" alone matches thousands of political posts a day and would burn the read budget.

tier_a_handles._note: Placeholder list. Every handle is TODO-VERIFY until the owner's ledger confirms the exact account. Handles are only searched when status is "verified" (or use_unverified is true), so a wrong or look-alike account never gets a reply.

x._note: X API v2 recent search. The X docs list min_likes (not min_faves, which X rejects with a 400). If min_likes is rejected the function drops it once, remembers that, and filters likes in code. Searches with a like threshold use a rolling start_time window instead of since_id, because since_id would skip a post that crosses the threshold after its ID range was passed; X bills a re-read of the same post once per UTC day. Plain searches (Tier A) use since_id.
x._expand_authors_note: "on_alert" looks up the @handle only for a post that reaches the council (about $0.010 per user read). "always" adds expansions=author_id to every search, as first specified, and pays for every author.

score._note: HOT = young and taking off: reply now. WARM = older but still growing: our own post. Growth compares this check with the last check (about 10 minutes apart). Views are X impressions; engagement = likes + reposts + replies + quotes.

limits._note: Netlify stops a scheduled function at 30 seconds. run_budget_ms leaves room to save state; a council that would not finish in time is skipped and logged, never sent half-checked.

council._note: Mini council: DRAFT model writes, a separate JUDGE model grades on the iSWEAT 3.9.3 X lens. Weights are the X column of iSWEAT 3.9.3 section 8.6.9. Ryan floor 6.0 is the iSWEAT social floor.

safety._note: Minor Shield: child names are stored only as SHA-256 hashes of the lowercase word (same method as scripts/test-clancy-child-names.mjs), so this file never spells them out. Patterns are case-insensitive regular expressions.
safety._minor_name_hashes_note: First three: the Clancy children (copied from scripts/test-clancy-child-names.mjs). Last two: the two child victims in the Vallow case. A post naming any of them is skipped, and a draft naming them fails. Add more with: node -e "console.log(require('crypto').createHash('sha256').update('name'.toLowerCase()).digest('hex'))"
safety._guilt_note: Checked only when the calendar row does not record a conviction. Exact negatives such as "pleaded not guilty" or "has not been convicted" are removed before this check.
